id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_005.pack|cs_: "How lively it is, sister. It's like a festival is about to start.
"Gallopolis is called the Kingdom of Knights. Behind the castle there's a racetrack over the oasis, where horse races are held.
"When I came before, I heard a special race is held once a year. I bet that's why it's so lively now.
"Hmm. Horse races sound fun, but our goal is the Great Tree's branch. Don't forget, shorty.
"Don't be such a killjoy. {var:1}, ignore that guy and let's enjoy this town.
"Don't be such a killjoy. {var:1}, ignore him and let's enjoy this town.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Ahem... Today the weather is splendid, fitting for the Faris Cup race celebrating my prince's sixteenth birthday...
"No, that's not it. This speech is too ordinary... It won't please the people.
"Hm? Who are you? I've no time to deal with visitors now. Come back later...
"Never bend his beliefs, and be loyal to his land! Help the weak, crush the strong! Face any hardship squarely!
"Good. I see you haven't forgotten the spirit of chivalry today.
"Faris, you're sixteen this year. In the Faris Cup, I expect a brave ride worthy of the Kingdom of Knights' prince.
"Leave it to me, Father. I will certainly meet your expectations. Now, if you'll excuse me...
"Pardon me, traveler. Your name? ...Hm, {var:1}, is it? What brings you to Gallopolis?
{var:1} explained that they came to Gallopolis seeking the Great Tree's branch.
"The Great Tree's branch...? Do you mean Gallopolis's national treasure, the rainbow-colored branch?
"...I may be able to help. Later, go down the grand staircase and turn left to my room. I'll be waiting.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Oh, you came. Sorry to call you out like this.
"Yes, yes. Just as I thought. Your height and build are perfect, and you look skilled with horses.
"You came seeking the Rainbough, right? Sadly, it's a national treasure. We can't give it to travelers.
"...But if I speak to Father, he'd surely give it up. In return... I need you to do something for me.
"No telling who's listening here. How about we talk while watching the show of the circus troupe now in town?
"...Excuse me, what are you saying? You might get the Rainbough. There's no reason to refuse.
"Of course, no problem. How lovely to talk with a prince while watching the circus.
"Settled, then. Come to the circus tent in the town tonight. Please don't be late.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Now! Next up, a mysterious traveling performer who flies around the world, charms every town, and leaves!
"The wandering entertainer... Sylvando!! Behold his wondrous show!!
"I'd never let a precious guest get hurt. Did you enjoy yourselves?
"...Just kidding. Hee hee. I'd never let a precious guest get hurt. Did you enjoy yourselves?
"...Everyone's absorbed in the circus. Now, to the main point. Please don't tell anyone what I'm about to say.
"Soon the knights will compete in horsemanship in a race called the Faris Cup.
"I'm entering too, but there's one big problem. The truth is...
"I've never ridden a horse and run in my whole life...
"Until now, with my subordinates' help, I've deceived Father and the people, but in the race the truth will come out.
"But this race celebrates my sixteenth birthday, so I can't skip it. I've been agonizing over it all along.
"Then you appeared. Someone with the same build as me. You're the perfect body double.
"Even as a body double, you'd be spotted at once in the race, wouldn't you? How would you fool them?
"Ha, no worry. Royals wear armor and helmets for safety. No one will ever know.
"Please! This is the favor of a lifetime! Pretend to be me in my place and enter the race! Please!
"What's that? That's cheating. {var:1}, you don't need to hear this request.
"Oh? Should you say that? Don't you want the Rainbough?
"Ugh... That's the worst...
"Hee hee, say what you like. I can't be picky about methods. So, you'll enter the race for me, right?
"Sorry, sorry. The applause was too loud to hear. You'll enter the race for me, right?
"Wonderful! I knew you'd say so! Once the race ends safely, I promise to speak to Father about the Rainbough!
"I've booked an inn for you today, so stay there. Tomorrow, come to the royal waiting room at the Race House.
"The Race House entrance is on the town's west side. Don't get lost. Now, I'll take my leave.
Through Prince Faris's arrangement, {var:1} and company spent the night at an inn in the town.
And then dawn broke!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_040.pack|cs_: "What a cheer. As expected of the prince of the Kingdom of Knights.
"I'm Sylvando. One of the knights got hurt, so I'm entering in his place.
"Prince or not, I won't go easy. Let's compete fair and square.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Amazing, {var:1}! I never thought you'd win! You have a gift for horsemanship!
"Excellent, {var:1}! You proved you can ride a horse! That's enough!
"Well done, {var:1}! You're quite used to horses! I never thought you could run like that!
"Now, switch! I have to go out before everyone! It's my turn to ride!
"You saved me. I'll handle the Rainbough matter. See you later.
Thus Prince Faris, having shown a brave ride, was honored and cheered by people all over Gallopolis.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_070.pack|cs_: "Thank you, {var:1}. You saved my face. Now, about the Rainbough...
"Young master of the Kingdom of Knights! That ride was fantastic! I was moved!
"Oh, what a letdown. I thought it was a great race, but you swapped and cheated.
"W-what? What do you know? If it came out that the prince can't ride, we'd betray the people's expectations.
"I'm only doing this so no one feels bad. Everything is settled neatly, so what's the problem?
"Hmm, is it? Isn't chivalry about fighting fair and square even when you can't win?
"Silence! I am this country's prince! A wandering entertainer will not lecture me on chivalry!
"His Majesty calls for you. He seems deeply moved by your brave ride, Lord Faris.
"{var:1}, I'm in your debt. I'll handle the Rainbough matter, so come to the throne room later.
"So your name is {var:1}. Your ride thrilled me. If we meet again somewhere, take care of me.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_080.pack|cs_: "...I'm honored by your words. I, Faris, shall keep striving as a knight.
"Father, I have a request. Would you hear out the traveler over there?
"Oh, helping others, truly my son. You know chivalry well. Speak, what is it?
"Yes. The request is that the traveler there be given the rainbow...
"It's the scorpion monster! That scorpion has appeared again at the Celestial Sands! A patrolling soldier was wounded!
"Blast! That desert killer! It appears every year at this time!
"Protecting the nation's peace is a knight's duty! We'll send the finest knights to finish it off for good!
"That's it! Let my son capture the monster! You, grown as a knight, will surely handle this mission!
"A-a monster that has killed veteran knights one after another... I should go...? I can't match it...
"Ha ha! The strongest are always the humblest! And I see you can't stop trembling for battle! Reassuring!
"Right, Faris! Go! Capture the desert killer splendidly!
"Y-yes. Understood. I'll return to my room to prepare. Now...
"Sorry... the Rainbough must wait. I need to talk, so come to my room later.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_090.pack|cs_: "Please! The favor of a lifetime! Help me capture the monster!
"...You're the prince of the Kingdom of Knights, aren't you? Handle it yourself a little.
"Ugh... that's the problem... I've never done any training at all, and left all real fighting to my subordinates.
"As an only son, I was overprotected from a young age, and Father and Mother praised me for everything, however small.
"To not betray my parents' and the people's expectations, I passed off things I couldn't do as if I could.
"Meanwhile, my reputation grew far beyond my ability... and before I knew it, I couldn't turn back.
"But this time I can't fake it! Capturing that scorpion is impossible for me! So lend me your strength! Please!
"Don't say that. Think of it as for the country! Please! I'm begging you!
"Thank you! You're this country's saviors! If we capture the monster, this time I promise to speak to Father about the Rainbough!
"Then I'll wait by the castle gate! Come when you're ready!
"What a pathetic prince. I worry about this country's future...
"Sister, don't speak ill of him. The weight of being a prince must be hurting him...
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_100.pack|cs_: "Why did you say you'd capture the monster?! We're the ones who'll fight, aren't we?! This time it's truly impossible!
"Hold on, don't worry, everyone. I've arranged a superb helper. Oh...?
"Good, you're here. Let me introduce {var:1} and his companions. They'll capture the desert killer.
"The desert killer's Pernicious Peninsula is at the far end of the Celestial Sands. First, pass the west checkpoint.
"Say, you're going to catch a scorpion, right? Sounds fun. Let me join in!
"Scorpions aren't fun. And aren't you a traveling performer? What about the circus?
"Hee hee. I'm more curious about that young master than the circus. So, can I come along?
"No need to be shy. I'm quite confident in a fight. Let's give it our all!
"I knew you'd say so. I won't be a burden, so don't worry. Let's give it our all!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Phew. Finally a place to rest. Let's rest here for now. We'll catch the scorpion tomorrow.
"...What? You came too. As you see, we're setting up camp here for tomorrow.
"Yes, I agree with resting here. The scorpion is rumored to be tough.
"{var:1}, let's rest to prepare for battle too.
"A traveling party of two men and two women, how romantic. Why are you traveling anyway?
"To unravel all the mysteries of the Luminary legend, we're traveling to reach Yggdrasil.
"Perhaps in the near future the day will come when we fight the evil god who brought calamity to the world...
"No, Serena! Don't tell a stranger, a mere entertainer, so much!
"Oh my! An evil god who steals everyone's smiles, a villain who may be revived soon...
"And you're traveling to defeat him?! How exciting!
"...Swallowing a story like that. You're a strange one.
"What about you, Sylvando? Why are you traveling?
"Hee hee. Never mind me. ...Now, tomorrow is the showdown with the scorpion. Enough chatter, let's sleep.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_120.pack|cs_: "What, nothing here. Fine, I'll report to Father that the desert killer feared me and fled.
"Eeek! It's here! P-prince! The desert killer... the Slayer of the Sands!!
"Here comes the scorpion! Show them what a prince of the Kingdom of Knights is made of!
"Honestly, what a hopeless prince! Soldiers, look after the young master!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_070_cs_140.pack|cs_: "It's finally calmed down. Now we just tie it with chains and carry it to the castle.
